points.description: States that the meter table collects flow statistics / holds a meter entry per flow.
States that this information is used by the controller for network management, e.g. QoS operations such as rate-limiting.

rubric.notes: Only the meter table is given in the model answer. Full marks need both the per-flow statistics/meter entries and their use for QoS/management (e.g. rate-limiting). Equivalent wording is accepted. Stating only one idea earns that point's marks.
